title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover the best environments for focused academic work at Augustana University, from quiet library stacks to modern science complex lounges.

cards.title: Third Floor Quiet Zone
cards.subtitle: Mikkelsen Library
cards.notes: Utilize the individual study carrels hidden among the book stacks for deep focus. This floor is designated for minimal noise and distraction-free work.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet floor featuring individual carrels and extensive book collections for focused research.
cards.evidence_claim: The third floor of Mikkelsen Library is a designated quiet floor with study cubes hidden by bookshelves.
cards.source_title: Best study spots on campus | Augustana University
cards.access_notes: Open to students and the public; check library hours for late-night access during the academic year.

cards.title: Glass-Enclosed Study Nooks
cards.subtitle: Froiland Science Complex
cards.notes: Study in modern, light-filled lounges with views of the central courtyard. These spaces offer a high-tech atmosphere near active research labs.
cards.short_summary: Modern collaborative and individual study areas within a state-of-the-art science facility.
cards.evidence_claim: The Froiland Science Complex contains a variety of technology-rich areas and glass-enclosed spaces for student collaborators.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; primarily used by STEM students but open to all.

cards.title: The Commons Front Room
cards.subtitle: Morrison Commons
cards.notes: Grab a large table in the front room for group projects or social studying. It is a central hub for student activity and casual academic work.
cards.short_summary: A social study environment located in the heart of the student union with large tables for groups.
cards.evidence_claim: The front room of the commons is a popular place to tuck into for studying, even for non-students.
cards.access_notes: Open daily during student union hours; typically high-traffic during meal times.

cards.title: 24-Hour Computer Labs
cards.subtitle: Madsen Center Lower Level
cards.notes: Access two 30-station computer labs in the lower level for late-night assignments. These labs provide 24-hour availability for students.
cards.short_summary: Reliable 24-hour computer labs equipped with 30 stations each for round-the-clock academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Madsen Center houses two 30-station, 24-hour computer labs in the building's lower level.
cards.access_notes: 24-hour access available for current students with valid ID card.

cards.title: Fireplace Gathering Spot
cards.subtitle: Mikkelsen Library Main Floor
cards.notes: Find a comfortable chair near the fireplace for a cozy reading session. This area offers a warm atmosphere for relaxed studying.
cards.short_summary: A comfortable seating area centered around a fireplace, ideal for reading and casual study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mikkelsen Library renovation included gathering spots around a fireplace and plentiful comfortable seating.
cards.access_notes: Located on the main floor; accessible during standard library operating hours.

cards.title: Northern Plains Research Library
cards.subtitle: Fantle Building
cards.notes: Research regional history in a quiet, specialized library environment. The space is dedicated to the study of the American West and Northern Plains.
cards.short_summary: A specialized research library and archive focused on Northern Plains history and culture.
cards.evidence_claim: The Center for Western Studies maintains a library in excess of 37,000 volumes and is open Monday-Friday.
cards.source_title: CWS Frequently Asked Questions | Augustana University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday, 8 a.m. - 5 p.m.; archives available by appointment.

cards.title: Flexible Living-Learning Classroom
cards.subtitle: Wagoner Hall
cards.notes: Use the flexible classroom space for evening study sessions or group meetings. This area is designed to transition from daytime instruction to evening study.
cards.short_summary: A multi-functional classroom space within a residence hall that serves as a community study area.
cards.evidence_claim: Wagoner Hall incorporates flexible classroom space that can be utilized for community interactions in the evenings.
cards.source_title: Augustana University, Ralph Wagoner Residence Hall - The Lawrence Group
cards.access_notes: Primarily for residents, but classroom spaces may be available for broader student use.

cards.title: Humanities Seminar Rooms
cards.subtitle: Fryxell Humanities Center
cards.notes: Reserve a seminar room for small group discussions or quiet individual work. These rooms are located near the English and Journalism departments.
cards.short_summary: Quiet seminar rooms ideal for small group collaboration and focused academic discussion.
cards.evidence_claim: The Humanities Center contains a variety of classrooms and seminar rooms for academic use.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; check for room availability between scheduled classes.

cards.title: Bookable Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Mikkelsen Library
cards.notes: Reserve one of the thirteen group study rooms for collaborative projects. These rooms provide privacy and necessary tools for team-based work.
cards.short_summary: Private, bookable rooms designed for group collaboration and project preparation.
cards.evidence_claim: Mikkelsen Library features thirteen group study rooms, including Room 310.
cards.access_notes: Reservations are recommended; priority given to current students and faculty.

cards.title: Commuter Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Madsen Center Room 152
cards.notes: Utilize this dedicated space for studying between classes. It offers a convenient location for commuter students to focus on coursework.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated lounge space providing a quiet environment for commuter students to study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Madsen Center contains a Commuter Student Lounge in Room 152.
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; specifically designated for commuter student use.
